cohort: 720 women of advanced maternal age undergoing a first fresh ET (n = 375) or FET (n = 345) between January 2016 and April 2021
finding: Frozen embryo transfer did not result in significantly higher rates of live birth than fresh embryos in women of advanced maternal age, and a freeze-all strategy may not be beneficial for these women.
birth_weight: Frozen embryo transfer resulted in higher birthweights (3217.16 +/- 734.44 vs. 3003.37 +/- 635.00, p = 0.037)
